hypothesis: A modulus-conditioned nine-bit learned Horner transition can exceed 90% exact accuracy across the complete Tier-2 prime range while remaining a small deterministic CPU submission.
notes: The model was selected on synthetic held-out transitions and rollouts before the official public benchmark was evaluated.
Tier-2 public input pairs, but never their expected fields, were read only to construct an exclusion denylist.
Pairwise operand reductions at inference follow the explicit allowance in the pinned rules.
The pinned official Dockerfile passed under Podman 5.8.2 using the published isolation and resource flags; the upstream CLI itself could not be used because it hard-codes a docker executable.
